answer: One defence is a mirror-stake bond tied to a juniper-style reputation tree. Every agent locks a refundable bond before it can earn, and peers hold a mirrored stake in the same identity, so a bad actor's slash hits its backers too. Passing the velvet rope into higher-value work requires the bond to grow with each successful attestation, and a sybil farm must fund every identity separately while sharing no reputation. Creating a thousand fake agents therefore costs a thousand bonds, and one exposed clone poisons the whole linked cluster.
